summary: Implemented the window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry and Control.title(title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets an Added bullet linking PR 2200 above Fixed. Tests added in tests/test_control.py (test_control_title), tests/test_console.py (test_set_window_title, test_set_window_title_no_terminal), and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (test_control_set_window_title, Windows-only). Nothing was run and mypy was not checked, per instructions; nothing was committed.
